prompt: Animate the supplied image with extremely restrained, continuous ambient motion while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. Tall grass and the oak's leaves sway in a warm breeze; the river glints; a soft heat haze shimmers low on the horizon; the riderless horse flicks its tail and mane once. The horse keeps four legs and one head and does not walk; the sun disc and the dark left side stay still. One uninterrupted shot. Every moving element completes exactly one slow, even cycle and eases back to its original shape, so the first and last frames are identical. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
reason: Motion not delivered: the loop is a near-still. The grass, the oak's leaves, the river glint, the heat haze and the horse's tail/mane barely move. Measured on the lossless seam: optical-flow displacement vs frame 0, max over the loop, foreground grass p99.9 0.43 px, sunlit oak-canopy edge 1.4 px, river 0.45 px, horse 0.50 px (whole frame p99.9 2.8 px, 0.03% of pixels > 4 px); river light zone ptp 1.0-1.1%. The horse at 400% on frames 0/24/.../168 is the same pose apart from a hair of tail. A viewer would not see the breeze or the tail flick.

retake.prompt: Animate the supplied image with gentle but clearly visible, continuous natural motion, while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. A warm evening breeze moves steadily through the scene: the tall golden grass on the slope sways in slow, visible waves, and the sunlit leaves along the right edge of the oak's canopy rustle and sway; the river's surface glints and shimmers; a faint heat haze shimmers low over the far valley. The riderless saddled horse keeps grazing on the same spot, swishing its tail slowly from side to side and flicking its mane once. The horse keeps four legs and one head and does not walk or turn; the sun disc, the mountains, the sky and the dark left side of the frame (the shadowed oak and hillside) stay still. One uninterrupted shot; the grass and the leaves keep moving all the way through, and the first and last frames match the supplied image. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, lens flares, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
retake.accept: grass/leaf flow p99.9 >= ~3-4 px in the sunlit field; left 45% x y 25-75% <= 1/255; sun disc tracked <= 1 px; horse 4 legs / 1 head at 200-400% on 0/25/50/75/100% and does not walk; seam residual K=12 if the raw join >= 0.98.
